headlines.title: What to Expect From General Motors’ Q3 2026 Earnings Report
headlines.summary: General Motors is expected to release its fiscal Q3 earnings this month, and analysts project significant EPS growth.

headlines.title: What GM exec says will keep the carmaker a sales leader: Not price
headlines.summary: In a conversation with other auto leaders, Duncan Aldred, head of GM North America, said GM is focusing on what comes in a car across all sizes.

headlines.title: FORTUNE ANNOUNCES ADDITIONAL POWERHOUSE SPEAKERS AND SPONSORS AT FORTUNE 500 INNOVATION FORUM, NOV. 16-17 IN DETROIT
headlines.summary: Fortune today announced an additional group of speakers for the Fortune 500 Innovation Forum, November 16–17, 2026, in Detroit, Michigan. The newly confirmed leaders will join CEOs, entrepreneurs, policymakers, investors, and civic innovators from across the country for conversations about the forces reshaping American business, technology, work, manufacturing, and prosperity.

headlines.title: Ultium Cells to invest $1 billion in Spring Hill battery plant
headlines.summary: Ultium Cells will invest an additional $1 billion at its Spring Hill facility to retool and diversify its battery cell manufacturing operations.

headlines.title: Ultium Cells to upgrade Spring Hill plant for prismatic LMR cells
headlines.summary: Combined investment for the LMR programme and its LFP energy storage system (ESS) production, together with facility improvements, will reach $1bn by 2030.

description: General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts worldwide. It operates through GM North America, GM International, and GM Financial segments. The company markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Baojun, and Wuling brand names. In addition, it sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts through retail dealers, distributors and dealers, as well as to fleet customers, including daily rental car companies, commercial fleet customers, leasing companies, and governments. Further, the company offers various range of after-sale services through dealer network, such as maintenance, light repairs, collision repairs, vehicle accessories, and extended service warranties. Additionally, it provides automotive financing; and software-enabled services and subscriptions. General Motors Company was founded in 1908 and is based in Detroit, Michigan.
